sentences.text: Fusuisaurus possessed a humerus measuring 183.5 cm in length.
Gregory S. Paul estimated the animal reached 22 meters long and weighed 35 tons, yet it maintained a relatively low body mass for such a large creature.
Remains of this dinosaur were discovered in 2001 within the Xinlong Formation of Guangxi, China.
The name Fusuisaurus translates to 'Fusui lizard,' referencing the county where the fossils were unearthed.
The type species, F. zhaoi, was named to honor the Chinese paleontologist Zhao Xijin.
Fusuisaurus belongs to the class Saurischia and is classified as a basal titanosauriform within the parent group Titanosauriformes.
This dinosaur lived during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago in the Aptian stage.
